title: Softmax-Free Attention in Spiking Transformers as Zero-Temperature Two-Level Systems: Applications to XAI
abstract: arXiv:2610.15968v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Spiking Transformer architectures usually drop the softmax, and some threshold each query--key score into a binary attention map. For such maps, the statistical mechanics of softmax attention does not carry over, because no temperature of the softmax gives a binary map. We show instead that each query--key link of threshold attention is a two-level system, as a spiking neuron is. Thus, a spiking Transformer with threshold attention is a zero-temperature network of two-level systems. In this picture, the attention map is a ground state, and the surrogate gradients used in training are susceptibilities at a finite temperature. Cooling trained networks from high temperature then shows that their predictions form gradually as their units freeze. translated_title: 脉冲Transformer中无Softmax注意力作为零温二能级系统：在可解释人工智能（XAI）中的应用
translated_abstract: 脉冲Transformer架构通常舍弃softmax，其中一些方法将每个查询—键得分经阈值化处理为二值注意力图。对于这类注意力图，softmax注意力的统计力学方法无法直接沿用，因为softmax在任何温度下都无法产生二值图。我们转而证明，阈值化注意力的每个查询—键连接都是一个二能级系统，正如脉冲神经元一样。因此，采用阈值化注意力的脉冲Transformer是一个零温的二能级系统网络。在这一图景下，注意力图是基态，而训练中使用的代理梯度则是有限温度下的磁化率。将训练好的网络从高温进行冷却，可以展示其预测随着单元的冻结而逐渐形成。利用这一冷却图景，我们将热力学积分方法适配到可解释人工智能（XAI）中。具体而言，我们将每个patch的二值单元，包括其神经元及其输入连接，加热到随机状态……（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 本文证明阈值化注意力的每个查询—键连接都是一个二能级系统，从而将具有阈值注意力的脉冲Transformer视为零温二能级系统网络（注意力图为基态、代理梯度为有限温度下的磁化率），并据此通过冷却与加热的热力学图景将热力学积分引入可解释人工智能（XAI）。
en_tdlr: This paper shows that each query-key link of threshold attention is a two-level system, so a spiking Transformer with threshold attention is a zero-temperature network of two-level systems (attention maps as ground states and surrogate gradients as finite-temperature susceptibilities), and it leverages this cooling picture to adapt thermodynamic integration for explainable AI (XAI).
